# Signet

Signet is a free online SSL certificate generator. It creates self-signed certificates, localhost HTTPS certificates, CSRs, Root CAs, host certificates, and mTLS client certificates entirely in the browser. Private keys are never uploaded.

Site: https://signet-lemon.vercel.app
Generator: https://signet-lemon.vercel.app/generate
Tools: https://signet-lemon.vercel.app/tools
SSL checker: https://signet-lemon.vercel.app/tools/check-ssl
Guides: https://signet-lemon.vercel.app/guides
